why: A delivers a cohesive warm reading nook: a black-brown side table matching the bookcase, a natural jute round rug, a softly shaded reading lamp and cream knit textiles. In B, the cold aluminium task lamp, the brass-and-walnut nesting tables and the synthetic shag rug drift away from the natural, warm look. In both, a single 90 cm bookcase falls short of filling a good part of the left wall.
